title: feat(roadmap): stage requires an eval replay task when a plan edits the stage prompt or gates
summary: The plan changes `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py`, a check of the stage job, and no group task runs `uv run devops roadmap eval stage --replay` or states the score before and after the change. The plan does not measure the change of the stage gate.
notes: The plan is one of this change before the check of #3331 exists: its one group changes `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py` and holds no eval replay task.
The change was never merged as this plan, so `pull`, `merge_commit` and `base_commit` hold the issue number and two placeholders: the case reads no commit, and the facts hold the files of its tree.

defects.problem: The one group changes `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py`, a check of the stage job, and no group task runs the replay with the score before and after the change. The change of a gate has no measure.
defects.evidence: The group lists `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage/stage_change.py` in `changes`, and its test, implementation and verify texts hold no `uv run devops roadmap eval stage --replay`.
defects.message: must run `uv run devops roadmap eval stage --replay` in one group task
